name: Presentr Practice
tagline: Mock job interviews: practice any role out loud
description: Mock interview practice for a specific job. Tell Cline the role you're interviewing for (and the company or job posting, if you have them) and Presentr Practice prepares a spoken mock interview with behavioral and role-specific questions, returning a link to start it in your browser. The interview runs by voice or text, in English or Spanish, and ends with a scored review: an overall score, a score per skill and coaching notes. No sign-in needed to connect.
